name: blender
description: Blender's light and camera words (#433): point and spot lights in radiant watts, a camera's lens and sensor, +Z up, each with its stated conversion. A word with no mapping is refused.

POINT.conversion: energy (W) × 683 lm/W; location Z-up to Y-up

SPOT.conversion: energy (W) × 683 lm/W over the whole sphere; spot_size ÷ 2 in degrees

Camera.conversion: lens and sensor to fov across the wider side; Z-up to Y-up
